name: FedEx Express National Hub - Indianapolis IN
type: Express national hub (2.4M sq ft, second-largest cargo facility)

fieldNotes.siteConfirmation: Roster point lands on the main sort building of the FedEx Express National Hub at Indianapolis International Airport. Confirmed via satellite (one very large dark-roofed sort building with airside aircraft positions and extensive ULD/air-container staging) and web research (Encyclopedia of Indianapolis / FedEx aviation page: built 1988, second-largest cargo facility in the FedEx Express system, ~6,000 employees, ~650 flights/month).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Web research explicitly references a 'Truck Gate' and a 'South Perimeter Security Station' controlling access to the hub. The facility sits entirely inside the secured airport perimeter; the support/parking area connects to the airside hub only through the staffed security station. Internal roads have no public Street View coverage (secured property).
fieldNotes.guardShack: The South Perimeter Security Station is a staffed checkpoint controlling vehicle entry into the secured airside hub.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — entry is staffed/screened, not kiosk-only.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Air-to-ground hub; landside truck/road-feeder docks line the sort building face. Door count is an estimate from imagery, well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Z20 imagery shows hundreds of ULD air containers and dollies plus straight trucks and trailers staged along the landside dock face; trailer (no-tractor) drop stalls estimated in the 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus includes the main sort building, several support/office buildings, and maintenance structures.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box approximates the core hub landside+building footprint; ~220 acres is an estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Lane counts at the security station could not be directly observed (no Street View on internal roads); estimated.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; airside facility.
